claim: Bi-Daily Song Discussion #126: Good Morning Good Morning
summary: 8.5/10 on the Sgt Pepper scale. I can understand some of the complaints -- Good Morning is mixed like a thick peanut-butter sandwich, there are only momentary bits of relief from the thick mix. Maybe if they had thinned out the "Good Morning" choruses and made the individual voices in the chorus more distinguishable/less echo it might have helped.
